indicators: Inputs (source declarations): length = input(title="Length", type=input.integer, defval=20, minval=0); src = input(close, title="Source"); squeeze_choice = input(title="Squeeze Type", defval="Within", options=["Within", "Width"]); widthRatio = input(title="Squeeze Width Ratio", type=input.float, step=0.1, defval=1.0)//If using width; fromMonth = input(defval = 1, title = "From Month", type = input.integer, minval = 1, maxval = 12); fromDay = input(defval = 1, title = "From Day", type = input.integer, minval = 1, maxval = 31); fromYear = input(defval = 1970, title = "From Year", type = input.integer, minval = 1970); thruMonth = input(defval = 1, title = "Thru Month", type = input.integer, minval = 1, maxval = 12); thruDay = input(defval = 1, title = "Thru Day", type = input.integer, minval = 1, maxval = 31); thruYear = input(defval = 2100, title = "Thru Year", type = input.integer, minval = 1970); B2mult = input(2.0, minval=0.001, maxval=50, title="BB Multiplier"); useTrueRange = input(true); Kmult = input(1.5, title="Keltner Multiplier"); partial1 = input(defval = 0, step=0.01, title = "Partial 1 Profit %", minval = 0)/100; partial1_quantity = input(50, title="Partial 1 Quantity (%)"); partial2 = input(defval = 0, step=0.01, title = "Partial 2 Profit %", minval = 0)/100; partial2_quantity = input(50, title="Partial 2 Quantity (%)"); take_profit = input(defval = 0, step=0.01, title = "Take Profit %", minval = 0)/100 | Indicator calls: sma(close, length); ema(close, length); ema(tr, length); sma(src, length); ema(src, length); ema(Krange, length)
entry_long: Source rule: midc[1]  equals  0 with all conditions true midc  equals  1
entry_short: Source rule: midc[1]  equals  0 with all conditions true midc  equals  2
exit: Source rule: partial1 exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Partial 1" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + partial1) , qty_percent=partial1_quantity); Source rule: partial2 exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Partial 2" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + partial2) , qty_percent=partial2_quantity); Source rule: take_profit exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Take Profit" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + take_profit) , qty_percent=100); Source rule: stop_loss exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Stop Loss" , from_entry = "LONG" , stop = close * (1 - stop_loss) , qty_percent=100); Source rule: stop_loss_trailing exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Stop Loss Trailing" , from_entry = "LONG" , trail_points = close * stop_loss_trailing / syminfo.mintick , trail_offset = close * stop_loss_trailing / syminfo.mintick, qty_percent=100); Source rule: partial1 exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Partial 1" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - partial1), qty_percent=partial1_quantity); Source rule: partial2 exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Partial 2" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - partial2), qty_percent=partial2_quantity); Source rule: take_profit exceeds 0; order: strategy.exit("Take Profit" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - take_profit) , qty_percent=100)
stop_loss: strategy.exit("Stop Loss" , from_entry = "LONG" , stop = close * (1 - stop_loss) , qty_percent=100); strategy.exit("Stop Loss" , from_entry = "SHORT" , stop = close * (1 + stop_loss) , qty_percent=100)
take_profit: strategy.exit("Partial 1" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + partial1) , qty_percent=partial1_quantity); strategy.exit("Partial 2" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + partial2) , qty_percent=partial2_quantity); strategy.exit("Take Profit" , from_entry = "LONG" , limit = close * (1 + take_profit) , qty_percent=100); strategy.exit("Partial 1" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - partial1), qty_percent=partial1_quantity); strategy.exit("Partial 2" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - partial2), qty_percent=partial2_quantity); strategy.exit("Take Profit" , from_entry = "SHORT", limit = close * (1 - take_profit) , qty_percent=100)
